summary: Seadrill Limited filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized extension of its existing $500 million share repurchase program through December 31, 2026. As of June 19, 2026, approximately $208 million of the authorized amount remained available for repurchases. Repurchases may be executed via open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, block trades, or tender offers. No specific price, premium, or advisor was named. The program may be modified or discontinued at any time. Watch for ongoing execution pace and any acceleration of buybacks, which could tighten share float and offer support for the stock.
